premerge_checks.body:
Residual subtraction still processed only eight columns per SIMD iteration and paid repeated slice/row setup. Add bounded 16-column kernels copied/adapted from goav1, with exact-width 4/8-column paths and conservative alias/short-window fallback. No new dependency or handwritten assembly.

On Apple M4 Max with Go 1.27.2, PGO off, six balanced native runs retain all 48 public component wins: **1.71–3.02× faster than the immediate parent**, with every paired sample at least 1.65× and zero allocations. Larger contiguous kernels also beat the old NEON path; padded-output old-reference cases select scalar fallback and are reported separately.

Whole-codec ARM VP9 improves **1.34% at 320×180 and 2.98% at 720p** versus the parent, all six pairs faster. It still takes 8.84%/35.22% more time than old assembly. The VP8 control is +0.49% with mixed pairs; residual subtraction has no VP8 production caller. These component wins remain useful independently of whole-codec results. Exact-head native x64 and optimized-libvpx results are complete below; Rosetta checks establish correctness only.

Full suite, ARM race/checkptr, AMD checkptr and actual AVX-off fallback pass. Differential coverage includes 5,760 geometries, read-only aliases, overlapping outputs, minimum windows, extreme/unused strides, and full post-panic state. PGO/fingerprint, noasm, SIMD selection and pre-commit gates pass. The native harness preserves all 282 existing cases and adds 48 identical public fixtures to both references; no correctness gate is relaxed.

Raw samples, sources, diagnostics, all outliers and reproducible scope are in `benchmarks/baselines/go127-simd-arm64/2026-10-18-residual-rows/REPORT.md` and its hashed archives. README files are untouched.

Based on merged #37 and #38. The latter’s native x64 audit retains its +0.88% whole-VP8 regression alongside 27/36 new SSE cases exceeding 1.5× in every sample; the full results and allocation outlier are preserved in the baseline archives. The rebase onto latest main preserved the complete successor tree, and all six locally measured source hashes still match.

Final exact-head `968b518b` evidence (Go1.27.2, PGOoff):

- On **EPYC 9V45**, all **48 changed subtraction fixtures improve versus the parent SIMD in every pair**: median **1.939–6.626×**, minimum paired gain **1.771×**. All 288 pairs exceed 1.5×. Old-reference ratios **1.697–19.379×** are versus **SCALAR fallback for all48 AMD cases**, because the pinned AMD fast selector always declines; they do not measure active x64 assembly. ARM contiguous-output NEON and padded scalar-reference results remain separately scoped.
- All **330 kernels × six samples × three variants** report zero bytes/allocations. Fourteen source hashes match, **123 targeted checks / 268 PASS lines** include all new subtraction tests under selected SIMD and race/checkptr, and no required test fails/skips. All22 semantic fields match across public/profile outputs. Preserve the **old-reference VP9 720 round4 allocation outlier 1.266667 versus modal1.25**; all current, parent and profile samples match their controls.
- Whole VP9 320 is **+0.4638% time versus parent** (3/6 pairs faster), while VP9 720 improves **−2.5042%** (5/6). They remain **−45.4753% / −52.8351% versus the old reference build** on this CPU. **VP8 is an unchanged-source control: +3.5742% versus parent** (1/6 faster), **+1.8878% versus the old build**. No VP8 algorithm benefit, universal x64 win or cross-CPU gap-closure claim.
- Keep **all167 median regressions and eight all-six-slower subpixel controls**, ranging +1.797–6.034%, with every raw pair. Subtraction itself has no regressing fixture. Short VP9 profiles sample the new bounded/16-row path; sampled times are not additive causal estimates.
- Optimized C is separately measured on **EPYC 7763**. Fixed-speed VP8 Go takes **2.362811× libvpx time** (+136.2811%; libvpx is faster), matching measured PSNR/SSIM/payload/frame counts without proving bitstream identity. This is a VP8 control for this change. Adaptive VP8 +77.6720% and VP9 +190.5841%/+200.7965% compare unequal quality/output work. Every quality-pass output statistic matches timed outputs in this job. All reference timers use `vpxenc-stats`; pinned ASM/SSE2/AVX2/runtime dispatch are enabled. Native/C hosts and different source checkpoints are never combined into a causal speed claim.

All three exact-head checks pass. Complete native86/C74 raw logs, audit, independent source/hash proof, output/allocation exceptions and report are preserved for the successor archive. README files remain unchanged.
premerge_checks.title: Optimize exact-row SIMD residual subtraction
